description: Hillside Family Medicine is running a hypertension quality improvement initiative. Your panel contains patients diagnosed with Essential Hypertension (ICD-10: I10). Audit the active problem lists and medication lists of all patients at the practice, identify those with hypertension who have NO antihypertensive medication currently prescribed, and for each such patient: (1) prescribe an appropriate first-line antihypertensive medication, and (2) create an encounter note documenting the medication initiation. Note: some hypertensive patients already have appropriate medications — do not duplicate their treatment. Credentials: admin / Admin1234!, practice: Hillside Family Medicine.
